item.description:
## Highlights
- Large-prompt serving keeps the model resident instead of evicting experts to SSD mid-request. The planned activation reserve was projected from the full prompt length against per-chunk measurements, promising up to twice the memory ceiling and forcing premature expert demotion during large prefills; the reserve is now resolved at the operation scope, matching the measured workspace. On the large sparse MoE with the drafter engaged at a 50,400-token prompt, the reserve dropped from 40-43 GB to under 3 GB and the mid-prefill demotion no longer occurs. - The menu's MLX memory legend no longer reports impossible values: the Owner overrun row is now expressed in the same scale as the other rows, so it can never exceed the ceiling.
## Compatibility
- No REST API, model-discovery, or configuration changes. Requests that previously completed (with avoidable SSD reads) complete the same way, with more expert retention.
## Distribution
- Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and stapled. The Sparkle update feed is signed and activated on the public appcast.
